## History

Priscilla Grant is a student who attends Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During her time at the academy, she forms a close friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as they adjust to student life and navigate their studies. She also shares in the anxious discussions among her classmates as they prepare for their final examinations and consider their future prospects.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends who attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together. They formed a close bond during their studies at the academy, navigating their academic pursuits and sharing life experiences alongside their circle of classmates. Priscilla remains one of Anne's primary companions throughout their term as they prepare for their final examinations.
